g.title: KEYCABLE
g.text: key motor cable (supplied with the motor)
plug it into the E0 motor header. Shorten only if the key's StallGuard reads too dull (bench stage 5).

g.title: PIGTAIL
g.text: UART pigtail — 6 F-F jumpers, one end cut off each
each lead keeps a female Dupont end; cut to measured length + a few cm

g.title: SPLICE
g.text: solder + heat shrink, zip-tied to the deck. R1 1 kΩ sits in line in the TX2 lead (revision 2026-10-08.2)

g.title: MS3_X
g.text: X socket MS3 jumper pin (jumper OFF)

g.title: MS3_Y
g.text: Y socket MS3 jumper pin (jumper OFF)

g.title: MS3_Z
g.text: Z socket MS3 jumper pin (jumper OFF)

g.title: MS3_E0
g.text: E0 socket MS3 jumper pin (jumper OFF)
